# 🐾 Red Puppy Iron Golem – Resource Pack

Give your world's guardians a splash of paw-some style!  
**Red Puppy Iron Golem** transforms the classic iron golem into a bold, adorable protector with a red puppy-inspired look. Stand out from the crowd and make your villages truly unforgettable!

## ✨ Features

- **Vibrant red puppy-themed textures** – Your golems will never look boring again!
- **Fresh personality** – Adds fun and charm to every Minecraft village.
- **Seamless compatibility** – Works smoothly with modern Minecraft versions and resource packs.
- **Easy installation** – Just drag & drop, no complicated setup.

## 🛡️ Why choose this pack?

Because every village deserves a hero with style!  
Let your iron golems show their personality, amaze your friends, and add a joyful twist to your Minecraft experience. Whether you're exploring, surviving, or building a paradise, the Red Puppy Iron Golem will protect you in **the most adorable way possible**.

*Download now and let the puppy power guard your world!*
